info.name: ZestalAI API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for ZestalAI - includes Authentication, Profiles, Social Media, Facebook Sync, GHL CRM, Scheduler, Phone Pool Management, AI Voice Assistants, Outbound Calling, Call Results, and Vapi Webhooks.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints for user login, signup, and token management.

request.description: Authenticates a user using email and password. Returns JWT token and user info.
Registers a new user account.
Checks if an email address is already registered.
Verifies if the current JWT token is valid.
Sets the user code for the authenticated user.
Authenticates a user using a Facebook access token.
Refreshes the user's Facebook access token.
Checks the status of the user's Facebook token.
Fetch user's Facebook posts and save to database.
Get user's Facebook posts from database.
Fetch comments for a specific Facebook post.
Facebook webhook verification endpoint.
Retrieves profile information for a specific user.

item.name: 3. Social Media
item.description: Social media posts and comments endpoints.

request.description: Retrieves all social media posts with nested comments and AI replies.
Triggers social media synchronization (posts + comments in background).
Marks a post as seen and its comments as not new.
Generates an AI reply for a specific comment.
Triggers a background task to scrape comments for all verified users.

item.name: 4. Facebook Sync
item.description: Facebook data synchronization endpoints for manual control.

request.description: Triggers a background job to sync Facebook posts.
Triggers a background job to sync comments for all posts.
Triggers a full synchronization (posts + comments).
Gets synchronization statistics.
Lists background jobs for the user.
Get status of a specific background job.
Lists contacts from GoHighLevel.
Get a specific contact by ID.
Creates a new contact.
Update an existing contact.
Delete a contact.
Add tags to a contact.
Remove a tag from a contact.
Add contact to a campaign.
Remove contact from a campaign.
Add contact to a workflow.
Remove contact from a workflow.
Lists tasks from GoHighLevel.
Create a new task.
Update an existing task.
Delete a task.
Lists calendars.
Get a specific calendar.
Create a new calendar.
Update a calendar.
Delete a calendar.
Lists campaigns.
List all pipelines.
Get stages for a pipeline.
Search/filter opportunities.
Get a specific opportunity.
Create a new opportunity.
Update an opportunity.
Update opportunity status.
Delete an opportunity.
Send email to a contact.
Send SMS to a contact.
Send WhatsApp message to a contact.
Get messages for a conversation.
List all tags.
Create a new tag.
Delete a tag.
List all workflows.
Get location details.
Get opportunity statistics.
Get comprehensive dashboard analytics.

item.name: 6. Scheduler
item.description: Scheduler and background job management endpoints.

request.description: Returns runtime status of internal scheduler jobs.
Manually triggers a specific scheduler job.
Pauses a specific scheduler job.
Resumes a paused scheduler job.
Logs lead information from the landing page. No authentication required.
Webhook endpoint for Zestal events.

item.name: 8. Phone Pool Management
item.description: Admin endpoints for managing Twilio phone numbers and the phone pool.

request.description: Search available Twilio numbers by country and area code.
Purchase a number from Twilio and add to the pool. Auto-imports to Vapi.
List all phone numbers in the pool with optional status filter.
Get pool statistics: total, available, assigned, released, error counts.
Assign an available phone number to a user.
Return an assigned number back to the available pool.
Auto-assign a number to a user. If pool is empty and auto-provision is enabled, buys a new number from Twilio.
Retry importing a phone number to Vapi if the initial import failed.
Release a number from Twilio and remove from Vapi. Sets status to released.
Get phone numbers assigned to the current user.

item.name: 9. AI Voice Assistants
item.description: Create and manage Vapi AI assistants with templates for structured data extraction.

request.description: List available call script templates with their extracted field definitions.
Create an assistant using a template. The template auto-generates the system prompt, first message, and structured data extraction schema.
Create a custom assistant with your own prompt and configuration.

body.raw:
{
    "name": "Custom Bot",
    "model_provider": "openai",
    "model_name": "gpt-4o",
    "first_message": "Hello! How can I help you today?",
    "system_prompt": "You are a helpful assistant. Keep responses brief and professional."
}

request.description: List all active assistants for the current user.
Get details for a specific assistant including system prompt and template.
Update an assistant's name, prompt, voice, or tools.
Soft-delete an assistant. Sets is_active=false, preserving call log references.

item.name: 10. Outbound Calling
item.description: Initiate single or batch AI phone calls.

request.description: Start a single outbound AI call. Requires an assigned phone number with Vapi import.
List all call logs with optional status and direction filters.
Get full call details including transcript, duration, recording URL, and cost.
Queue a batch of up to 50 calls with configurable delay. Runs as a background job.
Poll the status of a batch calling job. Shows progress, success/error counts.

item.name: 11. Call Results
item.description: Query structured data extracted from template-based AI calls.

request.description: Get the structured data extracted from a specific call (e.g., lead name, budget, interest level).
List all call results with pagination.
Filter results by template name (e.g., lead_qualification, appointment_booking).
Filter results by extraction status (pending, completed, failed).

item.name: 12. Vapi Webhooks
item.description: Simulate Vapi webhook events for testing. In production, Vapi sends these automatically.

request.description: Simulate a Vapi end-of-call-report webhook with structured data extraction.
Test webhook authentication — should return 401 with wrong secret.
